title: Vibe coding a MMO Throne Room Game in Space
author: certaintyisuncertain

comments.author: certaintyisuncertain
comments.body:
Built out the map system more. In the example, Heronfell is actually another player I had setup.

Uncharted spots are systems that other players will eventually inhabit. 

They’re treated in the lore as chaotic systems. And the lore has been updated so when you sign your Charter to start the game, you are a house rising out of that chaos in your system.

The lore is that there was a war with the robots 800 years ago and many systems fell into a dark age afterwards. You and all the other players are noble houses bringing order (or trying) to that chaos— rising humanity out of that dark age. 

Some systems around you will be run by AI, but a lot will be real players.

Everyone, once through the onboarding, will take one turn per day. 

Comms take at least that long to travel between systems, so there’s an in-world reason for this delay. The flow of information will be a big part of the game.

Now I’m working on the Letters system. This allows you to communicate with the AI systems and with other player systems, and what you communicate is records in-world and effects what happens.

comments.author: certaintyisuncertain
comments.body: Oh! And your star system actually has “bodies” and “infrastructure” making your dominion more tangible.
